༄༅/ /'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/yi ge gcig ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ yi ge gcig ma bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sha ta sa ha sri ka pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ tad+ya thā/ mu ne dharme/ saṃ gra dharme/ sa ta a nu gra ha dharme/ bhai sha pa na sa pa/ ka ra ya/ pra ri ti pa dharme/ bhai sha pa na sa bho dhe dharme/ sarba ka ra ya/ pra ta pha te dharme/ tad+ya thā/ shrī su ti smri te/ dza ya bā dzi ye/ dha ra ra ni pradz+nyā+e pa re swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor ci sngon dngos po yod pa yang med/ dngos po med pa yang med/ ngo bo nyid kyang med/ gzhan gyis dngos po yang med na/ de la gang yang yongs su shes par 'gyur ba'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba lta ga la yod par 'gyur re skan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa rdzogs so// 'di bton pas yum chen mo bton pa dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ pañca bid sha te sa ha sri ka pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ pradz+nyā+e pradz+nyā+e ma hā pradz+nyā+e/ a ba bha se pradz+nyā sarba ka ra thā thra kar bhi thā/ ma ni su tra ti man bha ga wa te/ sarba dz+nya na su dha ri ba sa hri ta ye/ ma hā saṃ ga ti/ si ti si ti/ bhu dhu bhu dhu/ kaṃ pa ya kaṃ pa ya/ swa la swa la/ dha ra dha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ gardza gardza/ a gad dza ya/ a gad dza ya/ wa ka dza ya/ ma bhi laṃ bha swā hā/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa rdzogs so/// /'di bton pas nyis khri bton pa dang mnyam par 'gyur ro// ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya aṣ+ṭa sa ha sri ka pradz+nyāk+s+ya pa ra mi ta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā hri su ti smri ti/ dza ya bī dza ya/ dha na dha ri ni/ pradz+nyā pa re swā hā/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa rdzogs so/// /'di bton pas 'phags pa brgyad stong pa bton par 'gyur ro// bsod nams 'phel/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ e ka ak+ṣa ri pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta ma na ma/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag kis thos pa dus cig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod phung pa'i ri la dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba 'di/

sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zungs shig /'di lta ste/ aḥ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ dge slong de dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ na mo mañju shrī ku ma ra bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ni bi sho dha ni/ sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a ma le bi ma le/ nir ma le/ dza ya ba te/ ru ru tsa le/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ shes rab dang blo 'phel bar gyur cig// /
